headerDisplay: Expose your Tethral routines as HomeKit Switches. Toggling a Switch fires the corresponding routine on Tethral. Switches auto-return to off after firing (stateless trigger pattern). Tap the link in the docs for help generating an API token.
footerDisplay: Need an API token? Contact Tethral support for the beta program. Self-serve token issuance ships with the Tethral web app.

name.title: Name
name.description: Display name for this Tethral platform in Homebridge logs.

apiToken.title: Tethral API Token
apiToken.description: Long-lived API token issued by Tethral. Starts with 'tth_'.

apiBaseUrl.title: Tethral API Base URL
apiBaseUrl.description: Override for staging or local development. Leave the default for production.

pollIntervalSeconds.title: Routine Sync Interval (seconds)
pollIntervalSeconds.description: How often the plugin re-fetches your routine list from Tethral. Lower values pick up new routines faster but use more API calls.

executeTimeoutMs.title: Execute Request Timeout (ms)
executeTimeoutMs.description: How long to wait for Tethral to acknowledge a routine execution before treating it as failed.
